quote: Jørgensen (1994) conjectured that every 6-vertex-connected graph that does not have K₆ as a minor must be an apex graph.
note: The 1994 date refers to the original conjecture paper 'Contractions to K₈' (Journal of Graph Theory, vol. 18, no. 5, pp. 431–448). The date 2007 sometimes associated with this conjecture refers to when the problem was posted to the Open Problem Garden website, not when it was originally posed.
